UPDATE raw_hl7_doc rhd SET rhd.current_process_status = 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM std_ccd_doc std WHERE std.mpi = rhd.pidmpi AND std.flux_match_cd IN ('M','C_M','P_M') ) AND rhd.current_process_status = 36

Update RAW_HL7_DOC set current_process_status = 41 where current_process_status = 37 and pidMpi in (select distinct old_mpi from mpi_change where exists (select 1 from raw_hl7_doc h where h.pidMPI=mpi_change.old_mpi) and not exists (select 1 from std_ccd_doc s where s.MPI=mpi_change.old_mpi ) and exists (select 1 from std_ccd_doc s2 where s2.MPI=mpi_change.current_mpi and s2.matched_stateno is not null) union select distinct current_mpi from mpi_change where exists (select 1 from raw_hl7_doc h where h.pidMPI=mpi_change.current_mpi) and not exists (select 1 from std_ccd_doc s where s.MPI=mpi_change.current_mpi) and exists (select 1 from std_ccd_doc s2 where s2.MPI=mpi_change.old_mpi and s2.matched_stateno is not null))

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT UPPER(trim(FIRST_VALUE (std.fname IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING))) fName, COUNT (DISTINCT std.fname) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id) fname_count, UPPER(trim(FIRST_VALUE (std.mname IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING))) mName, COUNT (DISTINCT std.mname) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id) mname_count, UPPER(trim(FIRST_VALUE (std.lname IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING))) lName, COUNT (DISTINCT std.lname) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id) lname_count, CASE FIRST_VALUE (std.ethnicity IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) WHEN '01' THEN 'HISPANIC' WHEN '02' THEN 'NOT HISPANIC' WHEN '09' THEN 'UNKNOWN' END as ethinicity, COUNT (DISTINCT std.ethnicity) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id) ethnicity_count, FIRST_VALUE (std.mpi IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) mpi, COUNT (DISTINCT std.mpi) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id) mpi_count, FIRST_VALUE (std.ssn IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) ssn, COUNT (DISTINCT std.ssn) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id) ssn_count, TO_CHAR(FIRST_VALUE (std.date_of_birth IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING),'MM/DD/YYYY') dobText, COUNT (DISTINCT std.date_of_birth) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id) dob_count, FIRST_VALUE (std.gender IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) gender, COUNT (DISTINCT std.gender) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id) gender_count, FIRST_VALUE (std.MED_RECORD_NUMBER IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) medRecordNos, COUNT (DISTINCT std.MED_RECORD_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id) mrn_count, FIRST_VALUE (PDC.STATENO IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) ccdMatchedStateNo, TO_CHAR(MIN(STD.DATE_RECEIVED) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id),'MM/DD/YYYY') startDate, TO_CHAR(MAX(STD.DATE_RECEIVED) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id),'MM/DD/YYYY') endDate FROM STD_HL7_DOC std LEFT OUTER JOIN PERSON_DOC_ASSOCIATION PDC on (STD.ccd_match_doc_id= PDC.DOCUMENT_ID and PDC.DISSASSOCIATION_DATE is null) where std.ccd_match_doc_id = #{docId} AND STD.CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 10 ) WHERE rownum < 2

select Distinct ADT.DX_CODE_ID dxCodeId, UPPER(trim(ADT.DX_CODE_TEXT)) dxCodeText, TO_DATE(substr(REPLACE(trim(ADT.DX_DATE_TEXT), '""', NULL),0,8),'YYYYMMDD') diagnosisDate, NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(substr(REPLACE(trim(ADT.DX_DATE_TEXT), '""', NULL),0,8),'YYYYMMDD'),'MM/DD/YYYY'),'') dxDateText, UPPER(trim(NVL(std.PROVIDER_FNAME,'')|| ' '|| NVL(std.PROVIDER_LNAME,''))) as providerName, UPPER(trim(STD.FACILITY_NAME)) facName from raw_hl7_adt_dg1 ADT, STD_HL7_DOC STD where STD.DOCUMENT_ID = ADT.HL7_DOC_ID and STD.ccd_match_doc_id = #{docId} AND STD.CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 10 and STD.DATE_RECEIVED >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') and STD.DATE_RECEIVED <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') and ADT.DX_DATE_TEXT is not null ORDER BY diagnosisDate

select distinct TO_DATE(substr(PHARM.DATETIME_OF_TRANSACTION,0,8),'YYYYMMDD') medicationDate, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(substr(PHARM.DATETIME_OF_TRANSACTION,0,8),'YYYYMMDD'),'MM/DD/YYYY') dateTimeofTransaction, UPPER(trim(NVL(PHARM.ORDER_PROVIDER_FNAME,'')|| ' '|| NVL(PHARM.ORDER_PROVIDER_LNAME,''))) as orderProviderName, UPPER(trim(PHARM.ORDERING_FACILITY_NAME)) orderingFacilityName, UPPER(trim(nvl(PHARM.RXE_MED_NAME, PHARM.RXO_MED_NAME))) medicationName from raw_hl7_pharm PHARM, STD_HL7_DOC STD WHERE STD.DOCUMENT_ID = PHARM.HL7_DOC_ID and STD.CCD_MATCH_DOC_ID = #{docId} AND STD.CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 10 and STD.DATE_RECEIVED >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') and STD.DATE_RECEIVED <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') and ( PHARM.DATETIME_OF_TRANSACTION is not null or PHARM.ORDER_PROVIDER_FNAME is not null or PHARM.ORDER_PROVIDER_LNAME is not null or PHARM.ORDERING_FACILITY_NAME is not null or PHARM.RXE_MED_NAME is not null or PHARM.RXO_MED_NAME is not null) ORDER BY medicationDate

select distinct STD.DATE_RECEIVED encounterDate, TO_CHAR((STD.DATE_RECEIVED),'MM/DD/YYYY') DATERECEIVED, UPPER(trim(HET.EVENT_DESCRIPTION)) EVNEVENTTYPE, UPPER(trim(STD.FACILITY_NAME)) FACILITYNAME, RHD.PIDPATIENTACCOUNTNUM ENCOUNTERID, UPPER(trim(NVL(STD.PROVIDER_FNAME,'')|| ' '|| NVL(STD.PROVIDER_LNAME,''))) as PROVIDERNAME from RAW_HL7_DOC RHD, STD_HL7_DOC STD, CODED_HL7_EVENT_TYPE HET WHERE STD.DOCUMENT_ID = RHD.DOCUMENT_ID AND RHD.evneventtype = HET.EVENT_TYPE AND STD.CCD_MATCH_DOC_ID = #{docId} AND STD.CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 10 and STD.DATE_RECEIVED >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') and STD.DATE_RECEIVED <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') and (STD.DATE_RECEIVED is not null or HET.EVENT_DESCRIPTION is not null or STD.FACILITY_NAME is not null or RHD.PIDPATIENTACCOUNTNUM is not null or STD.PROVIDER_FNAME is not null or STD.PROVIDER_LNAME is not null ) ORDER BY encounterDate

SELECT HL7_LAB_TEST_ID as hl7labTestId, OBRCOLLECTIONDATE, TO_CHAR(OBRCOLLECTIONDATE,'MM/DD/YYYY') as obrCollectionDateStr, TO_CHAR(OBROBSERVATIONDATE,'MM/DD/YYYY') as obrObservationDateStr, UPPER(trim(NVL(OBRPROVIDERFIRSTNAME,'')|| ' '|| NVL(OBRPROVIDERLASTNAME,''))) as obrProviderName, COALESCE(OBRLOINCCODE, OBRTESTCODE, OBRALTTESTCODE) as obrLoincCode, UPPER(trim(COALESCE(OBRLOINCDESC, OBRTESTDESC, OBRALTTESTDESC))) obrLoincDesc FROM RAW_HL7_LAB_TEST RHLT, STD_HL7_DOC STD WHERE STD.CCD_MATCH_DOC_ID = #{docId} AND STD.CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 10 and STD.DATE_RECEIVED >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') and STD.DATE_RECEIVED <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') AND RHLT.HL7_DOC_ID = STD.DOCUMENT_ID AND(OBRCOLLECTIONDATE is not null or OBROBSERVATIONDATE is not null or OBRPROVIDERFIRSTNAME is not null or OBRPROVIDERLASTNAME is not null) order by OBRCOLLECTIONDATE, obrLoincCode

SELECT HL7_LAB_TEST_ID as hl7labTestId, UPPER(trim(COALESCE(obxloinccode, obxtestcode, obxalttestcode))) as obxLoincCode, UPPER(trim(NVL(OBXOBSERVATIONRESULTTEXT,''))) ||' '|| UPPER(trim(NVL(OBXUNITOFMEASURE,''))) as obxObservationResultText, UPPER(trim(COALESCE(obxloincdesc, obxtestdesc, obxalttestdesc))) obxLoincDesc FROM RAW_HL7_LAB_RESULT WHERE HL7_LAB_TEST_ID = #{labtestId}

WITH data AS ( select Distinct ccd_match_doc_id, CASE WHEN SUM(RACE_ASIAN) OVER (PARTITION BY ccd_match_doc_id) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END raceAsian, CASE WHEN SUM(RACE_BLACK) OVER (PARTITION BY ccd_match_stateno) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END raceBlack, CASE WHEN SUM(RACE_INDIAN) OVER (PARTITION BY ccd_match_stateno) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END raceIndian, CASE WHEN SUM(RACE_OTHER) OVER (PARTITION BY ccd_match_stateno) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END raceOther, CASE WHEN SUM(RACE_PACIFIC) OVER (PARTITION BY ccd_match_stateno) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END racePacific, CASE WHEN SUM(RACE_WHITE) OVER (PARTITION BY ccd_match_stateno) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END raceWhite, CASE WHEN SUM(RACE_UNKNOWN) OVER (PARTITION BY ccd_match_stateno) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END raceUnknown, RACE_OTHER_TEXT raceOtherText from std_hl7_doc where ccd_match_doc_id = #{docId} AND CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 10 ) SELECT Distinct ccd_match_doc_id, raceAsian, raceBlack, raceIndian, raceOther, racePacific, raceWhite, raceUnknown, LISTAGG (raceOtherText, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ccd_match_doc_id) raceOtherText FROM data GROUP BY ccd_match_doc_id, raceAsian, raceBlack, raceIndian, raceOther, racePacific, raceWhite, raceUnknown

select distinct UPPER(trim( case #{colsName} when 'ETHNICITY' then CASE ETHNICITY WHEN '01' THEN 'Hispanic' WHEN '02' THEN 'Not Hispanic' WHEN '09' THEN 'Unknown' END else ${colsName} end)) as Field from STD_HL7_DOC STD WHERE STD.CCD_MATCH_DOC_ID = #{docId} AND STD.CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 10 and STD.DATE_RECEIVED >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') and STD.DATE_RECEIVED <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') and ${colsName} is not null

select distinct TO_CHAR(${colsName},'MM/DD/YYYY') as Field from STD_HL7_DOC STD WHERE STD.CCD_MATCH_DOC_ID = #{docId} AND STD.CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 10 and STD.DATE_RECEIVED >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') and STD.DATE_RECEIVED <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') and ${colsName} is not null

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT UPPER(trim(FIRST_VALUE (std.fname IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING))) fName, COUNT (DISTINCT std.fname) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id) fname_count, UPPER(trim(FIRST_VALUE (std.mname IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING))) mName, COUNT (DISTINCT std.mname) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id) mname_count, UPPER(trim(FIRST_VALUE (std.lname IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING))) lName, COUNT (DISTINCT std.lname) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id) lname_count, CASE FIRST_VALUE (std.ethnicity IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) WHEN '01' THEN 'HISPANIC' WHEN '02' THEN 'NOT HISPANIC' WHEN '09' THEN 'UNKNOWN' END as ethinicity, COUNT (DISTINCT std.ethnicity) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id) ethnicity_count, FIRST_VALUE (std.mpi IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) mpi, COUNT (DISTINCT std.mpi) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id) mpi_count, FIRST_VALUE (std.ssn IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) ssn, COUNT (DISTINCT std.ssn) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id) ssn_count, TO_CHAR(FIRST_VALUE (std.date_of_birth IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING),'MM/DD/YYYY') dobText, COUNT (DISTINCT std.date_of_birth) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id) dob_count, FIRST_VALUE (std.gender IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) gender, COUNT (DISTINCT std.gender) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id) gender_count, FIRST_VALUE (std.MED_RECORD_NUMBER IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) medRecordNos, COUNT (DISTINCT std.MED_RECORD_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id) mrn_count, FIRST_VALUE (PDC.STATENO IGNORE NULLS) OVER ( PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id ORDER BY std.DATE_RECEIVED DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) ccdMatchedStateNo, TO_CHAR(MIN(STD.DATE_RECEIVED) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id),'MM/DD/YYYY') startDate, TO_CHAR(MAX(STD.DATE_RECEIVED) OVER (PARTITION BY std.ccd_match_doc_id),'MM/DD/YYYY') endDate FROM STD_HL7_DOC std--, PERSON_DOC_ASSOCIATION PDC LEFT OUTER JOIN PERSON_DOC_ASSOCIATION PDC on (STD.ccd_match_doc_id= PDC.DOCUMENT_ID and PDC.DISSASSOCIATION_DATE is null) WHERE std.ccd_match_doc_id = #{docId} AND STD.CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 10 and STD.DATE_RECEIVED >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') and STD.DATE_RECEIVED <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') ) WHERE rownum < 2

select distinct UPPER(trim(replace(PERSON_ADDRESS,'"',''))) PERSONADDRESS, UPPER(trim(replace(PERSON_CITY,'"',''))) PERSONCITY, UPPER(trim(replace(PERSON_STATE,'"',''))) PERSONSTATE, NVL(trim(std.PERSON_ZIP),'') || NVL2(trim(std.PERSON_PLUS4),'-'|| NVL(trim(std.PERSON_PLUS4),''),'') as PERSONZIP from std_hl7_doc std where std.ccd_match_doc_id = #{docId} AND STD.CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 10 and (std.PERSON_ADDRESS is not null or std.PERSON_CITY is not null or std.PERSON_PLUS4 is not null or std.PERSON_STATE is not null or std.PERSON_ZIP is not null)
and STD.DATE_RECEIVED >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY')
and TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') >= STD.DATE_RECEIVED
order by PERSONADDRESS

select distinct UPPER(trim(INS.COMPANY_NAME)) as companyName, TO_DATE(substr(REPLACE(trim(INS.PLAN_EFFECTIVE_DATE), '""', NULL),0,8),'YYYYMMDD') insuranceStartDate, NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(substr(REPLACE(trim(INS.PLAN_EFFECTIVE_DATE), '""', NULL),0,8),'YYYYMMDD'),'MM/DD/YYYY'),'') planEffectiveDate, NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(substr(REPLACE(trim(INS.PLAN_EXPIRATION_DATE), '""', NULL),0,8),'YYYYMMDD'),'MM/DD/YYYY'),'') planExpirationDate, UPPER(trim(NVL(INS.INSURED_FNAME,'')|| ' '|| NVL(INS.INSURED_LNAME,''))) as insuredFName, NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(substr(REPLACE(trim(INS.INSURED_DOB_TEXT), '""', NULL),0,8),'YYYYMMDD'),'MM/DD/YYYY'),'') insuredDOBText, NVL(REPLACE(INS.POLICY_NUMBER,'-',''),'') as policyNumber from raw_hl7_insurance INS , STD_HL7_DOC STD where INS.HL7_DOC_ID = STD.DOCUMENT_ID and std.ccd_match_doc_id = #{docId} AND STD.CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 10 and (INS.COMPANY_NAME is not null or INS.PLAN_EFFECTIVE_DATE is not null or INS.PLAN_EXPIRATION_DATE is not null or INS.INSURED_FNAME is not null or INS.INSURED_LNAME is not null or INS.INSURED_DOB_TEXT is not null or INS.POLICY_NUMBER is not null)
and STD.DATE_RECEIVED >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY')
and TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') >= STD.DATE_RECEIVED
order by insuranceStartDate

WITH data AS ( select Distinct ccd_match_doc_id, CASE WHEN SUM(RACE_ASIAN) OVER (PARTITION BY ccd_match_doc_id) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END raceAsian, CASE WHEN SUM(RACE_BLACK) OVER (PARTITION BY ccd_match_stateno) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END raceBlack, CASE WHEN SUM(RACE_INDIAN) OVER (PARTITION BY ccd_match_stateno) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END raceIndian, CASE WHEN SUM(RACE_OTHER) OVER (PARTITION BY ccd_match_stateno) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END raceOther, CASE WHEN SUM(RACE_PACIFIC) OVER (PARTITION BY ccd_match_stateno) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END racePacific, CASE WHEN SUM(RACE_WHITE) OVER (PARTITION BY ccd_match_stateno) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END raceWhite, CASE WHEN SUM(RACE_UNKNOWN) OVER (PARTITION BY ccd_match_stateno) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END raceUnknown, RACE_OTHER_TEXT raceOtherText from std_hl7_doc STD where STD.ccd_match_doc_id = #{docId} AND STD.CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 10 and STD.DATE_RECEIVED >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') and STD.DATE_RECEIVED <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') ) SELECT Distinct ccd_match_doc_id, raceAsian, raceBlack, raceIndian, raceOther, racePacific, raceWhite, raceUnknown, LISTAGG (raceOtherText, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ccd_match_doc_id) raceOtherText FROM data GROUP BY ccd_match_doc_id, raceAsian, raceBlack, raceIndian, raceOther, racePacific, raceWhite, raceUnknown
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mpi_change(CURRENT_MPI, OLD_MPI, DATE_RECEIVED) select Distinct h.mpi as CURRENT_MPI, c.mpi as OLD_MPI, sysdate from std_hl7_doc h, std_ccd_doc c where h.current_process_status in (5,60) and ((replace(h.fname,' ',null)=replace(c.fname,' ',null) and replace(h.lname,' ',null)=replace(c.lname,' ',null)) or (replace(h.lname,' ',null)=replace(c.fname,' ',null) and replace(h.fname,' ',null)=replace(c.lname,' ',null))) and h.dob_text=c.dob_text and h.mpi != c.mpi and c.CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS IN (10, 14) and not exists (select 1 from mpi_change m where m.old_mpi||m.current_mpi = h.mpi||c.mpi) and not exists (select 1 from mpi_change m where m.current_mpi||m.old_mpi = h.mpi||c.mpi)
mapper.select: WITH data AS ( SELECT Trim(regexp_substr(#{p_process_status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '[^,]+', 1, level)) process_status FROM dual CONNECT BY regexp_substr(#{p_process_status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '[^,]+', 1, level) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT b.process_status, COUNT(a.document_id) count FROM std_hl7_doc a, data b WHERE a.current_process_status(+) = b.process_status GROUP BY process_status
UPDATE STD_HL7_DOC SET CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 60 WHERE CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 5
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM raw_hl7_insurance WHERE rowid NOT IN ( SELECT Min(rowid) row_id FROM raw_hl7_insurance GROUP BY plan_id, company_id, company_name, company_address1, company_address2, company_city, company_state, company_zipcode, group_number, plan_type, insured_fname, insured_lname, insured_dob_text, insured_address1, insured_address2, insured_city, policy_number, ssn, medicaid_fname, medicaid_lname, medicaid_case_number, insured_phone_number, plan_effective_date, plan_expiration_date )
mapper.select: UPDATE raw_hl7_doc r SET r.current_process_status = 18, r.ccd_match_doc_id = (SELECT s.ccd_match_doc_id FROM std_hl7_doc s WHERE r.document_id = s.document_id and s.current_process_status = 14) WHERE r.document_id IN (SELECT s.document_id FROM std_hl7_doc s WHERE r.document_id = s.document_id and s.current_process_status = 14)
